images.title: A tabletop in A4 sheets
images.purpose: Shows a tabletop, seen from above, covered by 3 rows of 4 A4 sheets, with one sheet's size and area marked.
images.composition: One rectangle (the tabletop), large and centred, tiled by 12 equal sheets.
images.exact_structure: Plain white background, lots of empty space, the figure large and centred, thin dark outlines (#2B2B2B), flat fills. Only the labels listed appear; no other text, no scenery, no characters. A rectangle seen from directly above, 118.8 units wide and 63 units tall, outlined thick dark. It is tiled with no gaps by 12 equal rectangles in 3 rows and 4 columns, each 29.7 units wide and 21 units tall (sheets lying sideways), separated by thin dark lines. The top left sheet is filled teal (#0072B2); the other 11 are filled pale amber (#E69F00). Labels: 29.7 cm above the teal sheet; 21 cm beside the left side of the teal sheet; 623.7 cm² inside the teal sheet; 12 sheets below the tabletop; about 7500 cm² below that. Check: 21 × 29.7 = 623.7, 3 × 4 = 12, 12 × 623.7 = 7484.4, about 7500.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Use the sheet as a unit: 12 sheets of 623.7 cm² make about 7500 cm².
images.description: Shows a tabletop, seen from above, covered by 3 rows of 4 A4 sheets, with one sheet's size and area marked.
images.context: Matches the worked example: A4 sheet 21 cm by 29.7 cm, table covered by 3 rows of 4 sheets.
images.teaching_notes: Ask for a guess of the table's area before showing the count.

image_decisions.why: Estimating by covering with a known unit is a picture: the tiled tabletop shows it.
